description: Run bb threads on NanoGPT's models, unlocked by your own API key. Paste the key into a gear in the composer; NanoGPT checks it before bb stores it, and a rejected key unlocks no models. Answers stream in with a separate reasoning channel, and the agent can call bb's tools in your project. Needs a NanoGPT account and API key, and NanoGPT bills your usage.
